description: A date picker calendar built on react-day-picker. Renders a full grid with table, thead, and tbody elements. react-day-picker provides complete ARIA compliance including role="grid" on the table, role="gridcell" on each day, and automatic aria-selected management for selected dates.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the previous day
Moves focus to the next day
Moves focus to the same day in the previous week
Moves focus to the same day in the next week
Moves focus to the first day of the current week
Moves focus to the last day of the current week
Moves focus to the same day in the previous month
Moves focus to the same day in the next month
Moves focus to the next focusable element (navigation buttons or out of calendar)

focus.notes: Focus is managed within the calendar grid using roving tabindex. Only one day cell is in the tab order at a time. Arrow keys move focus between days. Navigation buttons (previous/next month) are separately focusable.

announcements: Each day announces its full date (e.g. "Tuesday, April 7, 2026")
Selected dates are announced via aria-selected="true"
Disabled or out-of-range dates are announced as disabled
Month and year are announced when navigating between months
screenReader.notes: react-day-picker manages all grid ARIA attributes automatically. The calendar uses a table structure with proper row and cell roles for full screen reader grid navigation support.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for day numbers and navigation text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for selected-day indicator, today indicator, and focus ring)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide an accessible label for the calendar using aria-label or aria-labelledby
When used in a date picker, associate the calendar with its trigger input via aria-describedby
Ensure disabled dates have a clear reason communicated to all users
When using date ranges, ensure the selected range is communicated (e.g. "April 7 to April 14")
Format date announcements in the user's locale for clarity
